\begin{example} \end{example}[Higher derivative estimates for the local heat equation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0281 ↗ lem:chow-ii-local-heat-bernstein-estimate 1. ch14:14.24\group Local Heat Equation

For every $m\ge 1$, repeated differentiation of $\partial _tu=\chi ^2\Delta u$, followed by the Bernstein argument of Lemma 6, yields on $\{ \chi >0\} \times (0,T]$ an estimate \[ |\nabla ^mu|^2\le C_m\chi ^{-2m}t^{-m}, \] where $C_m$ depends on curvature bounds and on derivatives of $\chi $ and $u_0$ through the orders occurring after $m$ differentiations. \end{example}
